amenitiesDescription:
Arrival begins in The Cathedral, an immersive lobby featuring a commissioned mural that establishes the cultural character of the building. The centerpiece is Faena Rose, a 45,000-square-foot cultural and wellness hub suspended between the towers. The club includes an infinity pool with panoramic Miami views, a 40-seat private screening theater, fine-dining restaurant, cocktail bar, cigar lounge, private dining room, billiards room, creative lounge, and content creation studios. At the Sky Bridge's summit, a full-length outdoor pool deck and terrace garden create one of the most extraordinary elevated social spaces in any Miami residential development.

At the podium level, the Tierra Santa Healing House is a world-class wellness destination with a hammam centered on Amazonite stone, longevity clinic, botanical steam rooms, red light therapy, cold plunge, and a full beauty arcade. Fitness programming includes a padel court, golf simulator, outdoor workout terraces, and dedicated pilates studio. Faena's signature cultural programming, with rotating art installations, performances, and curated community events, ensures the building operates as a living cultural institution.
description: Two 68-story towers by Rafael Viñoly on the Miami River, connected nearly 700 feet up by Faena Rose. 406 residences from $1.3M in Faena's first standalone residential project, a 14-acre cultural district.

Twin 68-story Viñoly towers, a Sky Bridge club 700 feet in the air, Tierra Santa spa, and five-star residential services, all at a starting price of $1.3M. If Faena succeeds on the river the way it succeeded on the beach, the appreciation trajectory for early buyers could mirror what the original Faena District delivered. The $30 million penthouse sale recorded in July 2026, the largest residential transaction ever on the Miami River, confirms that top-of-stack demand is materializing ahead of delivery. The September 2026 penthouse collection, led by a $39.5 million two-story Crown Residence, sets the published ceiling of that stack.

investmentThesis: Over $300 million in contract sales reported as of late 2025, with more than 20% of residences sold before groundbreaking. A $30 million penthouse sale recorded in July 2026 stands as the largest residential transaction ever on the Miami River. In September 2026 Faena published its first penthouse collection, led by a $39.5 million two-story Crown Residence, a collection ask distinct from that recorded sale. This is Faena's first standalone residential project, following the transformative Faena District in Miami Beach (Faena House, Faena Hotel, Faena Forum). A $38 million credit facility from Bank OZK supports the sales and marketing program. Groundbreaking is anticipated in the second half of 2026, with completion targeted around 2030. The broader site plan envisions a phased, three-block cultural district with a private park, wellness center, marina, and public art installations along the river. Landscape by Sasaki. With over $25 billion of nearby investment reshaping the Miami River corridor and roughly 10,000 residential units in the pipeline, the project is positioned at the center of Downtown Miami's most significant waterfront transformation.
name: Faena Residences Miami
residenceContent: The two towers sit on 327 feet of Miami River frontage directly across from Brickell City Centre. Viñoly designed them as a pair of offset slab forms that separate as they rise and reconnect through Faena Rose, a three-story Sky Bridge on floors 61 through 64, suspended nearly 700 feet above the city. Interiors by Faena Design Studio with Bryan O'Sullivan Studio bring Faena's signature warmth to a modernist framework: open floor plans with floor-to-ceiling impact glass, 10-foot-deep terraces, travertine flooring, custom Italian cabinetry, natural stone countertops, and Gaggenau appliances throughout. Every residence frames expansive views of the Miami River, Biscayne Bay, and the Downtown skyline. The penthouse collection includes Sky Villas with private terraces and pools, and a two-story Crown Residence at the top of the stack.
